hints.lines: Each Console.WriteLine() makes its own line. You should have exactly two lines.
hints.other: The second line is a sum. C# multiplies before it adds.

hints.compile: Look at the end of line 1. What does line 2 have at the end that line 1 doesn't?
hints.capitals: Check the capital H and the capital Y.
hints.punctuation: Keep the comma and the ! inside the speech marks.

hints.other: Put 7 * 8 inside Console.WriteLine() with no speech marks, so C# does the sum.
